name: lms-monorepo
description: LMS Client application for continuous biometric authentication telemetry collection demo.

scripts.install-all: npm run install-backend && npm run install-frontend
scripts.ml: cd behavioral-auth-ml-service/backend && (../venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000 || python3 -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000)
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run ml"
